questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Engelsktalende land, fag indenfor mine interesser og at der var flot natur.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt, det hele er tilgængeligt online

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der er personale ansat på universitetet som kan vise hvor man skal bo osv.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Jeg ankom et par dage tidligere end at aktiviteterne startede og det gav virkeligt god mulighed for at få sovet ud og lære campus at kende

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Man er sikret bolig når man er exchange

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde køkken og jeg ville klart anbefale at betale ekstra for det. Der er meal plans, men det brugte jeg ikke.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer:
Der er ikke nogen form for køkkenredskaber når man ankommer, så enten koordiner det med dine housemates eller køb noget billigt i en af genbrugerne. 
Det kan betale sig at betale mere for at bo i et townhouse.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man gør det allerede inden man tager afsted, deres system er lidt anderledes end vores, men man finder hurtigt ud af det. Der skal sendes nogle papirer til en vejleder, som man udfylder manuelt ved at slå kurserne op. Det er også nemt at skifte eller droppe kurser når man først er derhenne.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kan altid få fat i sin tilknyttede vejleder på mail, der er selvfølgeligt en tidsforskel, men det tager aldrig mere end én dag eller to.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg endte med at bytte rundt på en masse af min kurser alligevel og det lykkedes mig at få det kursus jeg helst ville have, selvom holdet var fyldt og jeg ikke have fået det i første omgang - de er meget hjælpsomme og medgørlige.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Bare spørg om hjælp hvis du er i tvivl

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet var lidt lavere end i Danmark, men det er egentligt meget rart.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Man har ikke øvelsestimer på samme måde. Forelæsningerne er kortere, men til gengæld flere dage om ugen. Undervisningen afhænger meget af den enkelte professor.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Apiculture & Honey Bee Biology
Environment, Justice & Society
Eating Sustainably in Ontario
Food Systems: Security and Sustainability

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Tag et kursus som du ikke kan tage hjemme! Jeg kan også varmt anbefale honningbi-kurset og Environment, Justice & Society. 
Jeg tog et online-kursus, det havde den fordel at jeg havde mere fritid, men det var heller ikke ligeså sjovt som de rigtige kurser.

questions.answer:

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Indkøb er rimeligt dyrt, men aktiviteter er rimeligt billige og man kan altid finde billige øl

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er en outdoor-klub, men den er lille så det var nemmere for os bare selv at planlægge ture. Jeg ville gerne have brugt klubberne mere, men jeg synes det var lidt svært og der var også mange andre ting jeg gerne ville.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Stort set alt man kan komme i tanke om

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Klatring og træningscentret (med hold)
Gå en tur i the Arboretum (stor park)
Se honningbierne
Deltag i exchange-aktiviteterne

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Toronto selvfølgeligt
Niagara Falls og Niagara-on-the-lake (by nord for Niagara Falls)
Algonquin National Park
Der er også hyggeligt ved Bruce Peninsula (se grotterne i området)
Jeg rejste både en weekend og en hel uge til Vancouver og det kan anbefales hvis det er i budgettet
Generelt bare kom ud og se noget vild og smuk natur!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Nemt, det minder ret meget om noget man kender

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Snak med folk til undervisningen

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Gruppearbejde og niveauet der er noget andet end derhjemme, men det var ikke så slemt.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer:
Alle er enormt venlige og imødekommende 
Tim Hortons<3

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Guelph er dejligt og jeg nød mine fag og oplevelser, men den helt store natur findes på den anden side af Canada.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Der findes en del gode genbrugsbutikker en bustur væk og det kan godt betale sig at finde ting der. 
Undersøg og planlæg ting du kan lave hjemmefra.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer:
At møde mennesker og få venner fra så mange andre kulturer
Få en relation til og forståelse af et andet land end Danmark.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At nå alle de ting man gerne ville nå

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
